prompt: Why will the speaker read each decision back at the next review?
promptZh: 講者為什麼會在下次審查時重唸各項決議？

options.text: To let people point out a difference before the drawings change.
options.zh: 讓大家在改圖前指出自己聽到的內容不一致。
options.whyZh: 有歧異的人可立即提出，以免按照不同理解修改圖面。

options.text: To save time by marking every decision as discussed.
options.zh: 讓所有決議一律標成已討論以節省時間。
options.whyZh: 勾記討論與重唸決議是不同做法；重唸是讓大家核對理解。

options.text: To invite everyone to submit new drawings during the review.
options.zh: 請大家在審查時送交新圖面。
options.whyZh: 沒有要求送新圖；重唸決議發生在改圖前。

options.text: To make the review log less detailed.
options.whyZh: 講者要用重唸確認內容，不是減少紀錄細節。

explanationZh: 有歧異的人可立即提出，以免按照不同理解修改圖面。
evidence: At our next review, I’ll read each decision back before we leave. / That gives anyone who heard something different a chance to speak up before we revise the drawings.
